title: Electrocardiography laboratory
summary: Read, analyse, classify, measure and report electrocardiograms, validated on the open databases.
description: An electrocardiography laboratory for Nelson: WFDB, EDF+, CSV and ISHNE in and out, preprocessing with a quality index, seven QRS detectors compared under ANSI/AAMI EC57, P-QRS-T delineation measured on the QT Database, AAMI beat classification, atrial fibrillation, heart rate variability by the Task Force definitions, the twelve-lead measurements, a calibrated strip, a summary page, a beat view and a report.
